thread:
maria (product): hey team — we need a quick alignment on the radial-stitch initiative sequencing. customer X wants private beta in 8 weeks, but infra/security/rt have different blockers. can we list gating items?
aj (eng-runtime): from runtime side, biggest risk is quantized model compatibility + canary rollout hooks. need model build by week 2 and a test VM pool.
sam (eng-infra): infra needs the staging subnet and reserved GPUs. I can provision a staging pool but need approval for quota bump and a list of instances; also timing for db migration window.
kevin (security): security review checklist: threat model, HSM/KMS integration, dataflow diagrams, and a penetration window. earliest review slot is week 3 unless we move pre-review docs today.
jen (pm): acceptance criteria draft: 95p99 latency <220ms (hosted-equivalent), automated smoke against 10 customer prompts, audit logs enabled, canary rollback plan. is that reasonable?
aj (eng-runtime): latency target may need relaxed for quantized 4-bit until we have kernel optimizations. propose soft target for beta: p95 <300ms, hard guardrails and monitoring.
maria (product): okay — can we sketch dependencies as: model build -> runtime canary hooks -> infra staging -> security pre-review -> smoke tests -> beta? who's owner for each?
sam (eng-infra): infra owns staging + quota. ETA: staging ready by week 1 if quota approved today. owner: @sam.
aj (eng-runtime): runtime owns canary hooks + kernel integration. ETA: model build by day 10, canary by day 16. owner: @aj.
kevin (security): security pre-review owner: @kevin. will accept early design docs; pen-test scheduled after canary signoff.
jen (pm): I'll own smoke tests and acceptance. will prepare prompt set and automation runbook.
maria (product): decision points for leadership: 1) approve quota bump (infra) 2) accept relaxed latency for beta 3) prioritize kernel work or delay beta. who needs to escalate?
aj (eng-runtime): if kernel team can't prioritize, we need a fallback: longer beta or smaller token limits per request.
sam (eng-infra): I can escalate quota to finance today. need a short doc with costs.
kevin (security): I'll block a 1-hour pre-review slot this Friday at 10am; please upload diagrams by Thu EOD.
jen (pm): I'll draft the costs + acceptance doc and upload to the thread. also adding a short checklist: [ ] quota approved, [ ] model build, [ ] canary hooks, [ ] staging up, [ ] security pre-review, [ ] smoke tests green.
maria (product): perfect. quick ask — can each of you drop a single-line ETA in this thread by EOD so I can pull into roadmap? :thumbsup:
aj (eng-runtime): ETA: model build day 10, canary hooks day 16.
sam (eng-infra): ETA: staging + quota day 1 (if approved) otherwise day 8.
kevin (security): ETA: pre-review Fri 10am, pen-test after canary signoff (~day 18).
jen (pm): ETA: smoke tests ready day 17, will run day 18.
maria (product): thanks — I'll assemble and share a short plan for leadership. tagging ops-bot to remind about quota approval.
deploy-bot: reminder set: "request quota bump" scheduled for 2023-11-03T09:00:00Z (will ping #product).
